label: Sense-mixing control for PRIOR_4 as mover priority, checked (inference)
rule: Two applications of mover priority contradict the definitional asymmetry of PRIOR_4
meaning: Read with PRIOR_4, priority from actual moving makes each of two reciprocally moving beings prior in being to the other, which the definition of PRIOR_4 excludes. So a respect-free premise like 6ca87431 cannot be read in the being sense where reciprocal cross-respect moving occurs; it is the PRIOR_4 form of the slice-1 reciprocity certificates. A premise-free control showing that mixing fails; it establishes nothing about which beings move each other.
